components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a page or form. Ember Orange Deep, 42px.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Add stock</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 42px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: #c2410c; color: #fff; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9a3412; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #7c2d12; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px rgba(249,115,22,0.5); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions next to a primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 42px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #334155; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f1f5f9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(249,115,22,0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 42px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #64748b; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #0f172a; background: #f1f5f9; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(249,115,22,0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field. 42px, Slate 100 fill, orange focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: #475569; } .ds-input { height: 42px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; background: #f1f5f9; color: #0f172a; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; outline: none; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 400; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #cbd5e1; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #f97316; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(249,115,22,0.25); }

components.css: .ds-badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-badge i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-badge-fresh { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.1); border-color: rgba(16,185,129,0.2); color: #047857; } .ds-badge-fresh i { background: #10b981; } .ds-badge-expiring { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.1); border-color: rgba(245,158,11,0.2); color: #b45309; } .ds-badge-expiring i { background: #f59e0b; } .ds-badge-expired { background: rgba(244,63,94,0.1); border-color: rgba(244,63,94,0.2); color: #be123c; } .ds-badge-expired i { background: #f43f5e; } .ds-badge-location { background: #f1f5f9; border-color: #e2e8f0; color: #1e293b; }

narrative.overview:
Pantry is a quiet, trustworthy record of a household's food. The interface behaves like a well-kept ledger. Content sits on clean, nearly opaque surfaces with even rhythm and predictable controls, so you can trust a glance on a phone in the kitchen as much as a planning session at a desk. The system shows information plainly and does not perform.

The atmosphere stays in the background. The app shell carries a static pale Morning Haze sky (soft radial glows and a faint 28px dot grid) behind every page. Content never competes with it: cards are 92–96% opaque, so the haze only reads at the margins. Ember Orange is the one warm note in a cool, slate-and-sky world. It marks where you act and where you are, and it does nothing else. Status colors (emerald, amber, rose) carry the food's condition and never decorate.

Density is moderate and intentional. Body text starts at 14px, every single-line control is 42px tall, and pages keep useful information visible instead of hiding it behind extra framing. Minimalism here means fewer decisions and clearer relationships, not less information. Light and dark themes are first-class peers; neither is the fallback.
keyCharacteristics: Cool slate neutrals over a pale sky-blue haze; Ember Orange reserved for actions and the current location.
Nearly opaque frosted cards, quietly layered on borders and tone rather than shadow.
One 42px control height and soft 12px corners across buttons, inputs, selects, and date pickers.
Native system sans with five named type roles; natural case, no tracked uppercase labels.
Emerald / amber / rose status language for fresh / expiring / expired stock.
Full light and dark themes, toggled by a `.dark` class. The first visit follows `prefers-color-scheme`.

rules.name: The One Warm Note Rule
rules.body: Ember Orange is the only warm hue outside status. It marks an action, a selection, or where you are. If an orange element is not clickable or current, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Status Is Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Emerald, amber, and rose describe the food's condition. Never use them for category color, branding, or emphasis. Always pair them with a label or icon; color alone never carries status.

rules.name: The Natural Case Rule
rules.body: Use sentence case for all UI text. Uppercase is only for a deliberate short overline, never for routine field labels. Do not combine `uppercase` with `tracking-*`.

rules.name: The Role, Not Size Rule
rules.body: Use the named role classes (`type-page-title`, `type-section-title`, `type-label`, `type-meta`, `type-value`) instead of ad hoc size and weight utilities. Keep each role's color token; a quieter weight must not make help text unreadable.

rules.name: The Only Floaters Lift Rule
rules.body: A surface casts a noticeable shadow only when it floats above the page (menus, overlays, dialogs). Content cards stay flat-feeling; to separate content, add a border or a tonal step, not a bigger shadow.

rules.name: The One Frame Rule
rules.body: Don't nest framed surfaces more than one level deep (a card can hold sub-panels; a sub-panel never holds another card).

dos: Do keep every single-line control at exactly 42px tall with a 12px radius.
Do use Ember Orange only for primary actions, focus, selection, and the current navigation location.
Do use the five named type roles and natural-case labels.
Do separate content with 1px slate borders and tonal steps before reaching for shadow.
Do pair every status color with a text label or icon, in both themes.
Do let the shell own outer gutters; pages set only their content measure.
Do verify light and dark themes together; check contrast against the composited card surface, not the raw token.
Do provide `prefers-reduced-motion` fallbacks for any animation.
Do use design tokens (`primary-*`, `surface-*`, `navy-900`) instead of hex values in templates.
Do use `pantry-confirm-dialog` for confirmations, `pantry-alert` for inline messages, and `pantry-segmented-control` for single-choice toggles.
Do use sentence case for all UI text.
Do keep touch targets at 42px or larger on phones.
donts: Don't use emerald, amber, or rose for decoration, categories, or branding.
Don't use tracked uppercase field labels or extra-bold headings.
Don't nest a card inside a sub-panel, or add competing headings and badge clusters around a task.
Don't add outer horizontal or vertical padding wrappers to pages.
Don't put content directly on the haze background; it belongs on a card.
Don't shrink desktop tables or controls to fit phones; restructure instead.
Don't hand-roll search inputs, spinners, skeletons, empty states, badge pills, segmented controls, alerts, confirm dialogs, native selects, or popup menus; use the `@ui` primitive or PrimeNG control.
Don't write long inline Tailwind button strings; use the `btn-*` classes.
Don't hardcode brand hexes (`#ea580c`, `#141c2e`, `#0d1322`, `#f8fafc`) in templates.
Don't introduce new control heights, radii, button variants, or badge variants without recording them in this file.
Don't use native `confirm()`, `pi-spin`, `font-extrabold`, `text-gray-*`, `red-*` colors, or text smaller than 12px.
Don't use an orange fill on an element that is not clickable or current.
